text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're halfway through the academy's
summer camp, and Nature has
already
gotten a lot better at running on the
beach.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well? Has my time improved or
what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her results speak volumes to how much
work she's been putting in
these past few
days.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can run pretty well on sand now, but I
wonder if that'll transfer to the
track.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no way it's gonna be that easy. For
one thing, everyone's
training just as hard
as we are.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I probably shouldn't be saying
that in front of the trainer
who's been
helping me train from dawn to dusk every
day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
let's just chalk it up to a defect in
my personality. Old habits
die hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We keep going back and forth like this for
a while...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there was gonna be a
festival—I should've brought my
yukata.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you can have fun at a festival no
matter what you're
wearing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, so there's a festival going on today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, good idea.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've got a soft spot for festivals.
Especially
the smaller ones—like at
the local park.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I used to go with my friends, and we'd get
up to all kinds of hijinks.
Man, good times,
good times.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I may not look it,
but they used to call me
the dancing queen!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, not like anyone cares though. But
hey, having festival dancing
as one of my
only talents is pretty on-brand, don'tcha
think?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, that's enough about the past.
Let's go see that festival!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man, nothing beats a summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, where to first? There's noodles,
grilled corn... Oh, grilled squid
sounds
good too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I've been training my butt off, so I
think I deserve a little treat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you gotta let loose a bit more. I
can't be the only one getting
all excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nature and I spend some time walking
around the festival...

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
You can register for the Festival Dance
Grand Prix here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Festival Dance Grand Prix?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! No no no no, wait just a second
now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I said my friends thought I was good at
dancing, not that I was
competition
material.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna dance, I'd rather it be in a
small park with people I know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not the issue here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really do lay it on thick when it
comes to coaxing me into
doing
something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Rather than dancing, let's go check out
some more stalls! I haven't
tried the butter
potatoes yet! C'mon, chop chop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go after Nature,
who's already dashed off
to the food stalls, leaving
the dancing
crowd behind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I'm stuffed. Might've gotten ahead
of myself on those
skewers.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've done what I came here for,
so wanna head back? We've
still got
training tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as we're about to leave the festival
and go back to the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Last call to sign up for the Festival
Dance
Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...H-hey.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really want to see? My... um,
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My friends said I was good,
but it's really
just your everyday festival
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha... I see. Then I'll enter.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But don't get your hopes up too high,
okay? It's been a minute since
I've done
any sort of dancing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Were you even listening to what I just
said?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nature signs herself up for the
Festival Dance Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
This year's Festival Dance Grand Prix
winner is...

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Number 12! Hailing from Tracen Academy,
it's the Umamusume—Nice
Natty!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's Nice Nature. Wait, no way? M-me?!

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Your enthusiastic performance went
straight after our hearts. All the
judges
picked you unanimously. Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Festival Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a round of applause for our
winner—Nice Natty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap clap clap!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, it's not Natty—Ah, thank you,
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wow...
didn't think I'd win the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks. I'm still not sure what got
into me, signing up for a
contest like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Who knows... maybe your bottomless
optimism has started rubbing off
on me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, don't worry—I'm still the same
wet blanket.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, tomorrow it's back to training!
Maybe I'll be the winner in my
next race,
too. One can always dream, right?
